scope: Owner telemetry registry, snapshot and BACKING-only totals; staging request/reset counters. Production owner wiring (game state, actor pool, tags, BSP, streaming, scratch, audio) is NOT yet connected to hcu_main.c.

owner_model.rule: Only BACKING owners are summed into backing_capacity/used/high/failures/resets. Nested rows are reported and validated (capacity <= parent capacity) but never added.

hook_signatures_for_renderer_lane.note: Renderer lane (dma-lifecycle) implements these; it must not edit hcu_owner_telemetry.*
hook_signatures_for_renderer_lane.bind: int hcu_owner_telemetry_bind_sampler(hcu_owner_telemetry_t *t, hcu_owner_id_t id, hcu_owner_sampler_fn sampler, void *ctx)
hook_signatures_for_renderer_lane.sample_contract: capacity, used, high (peak since last reset), failures and resets from the owner's own live counters; return 0 if not bound

needed: hcu_owner_telemetry_init(&g_owner_telemetry) at boot before any owner is bound
hcu_owner_telemetry_note_capacity for game_state, dynamic_simulation, tags, bsp, streaming, scratch, dma, audio_requests from the bound profile
hcu_owner_telemetry_bind_sampler for render_chunks and render_texture (renderer lane) and dma (renderer lane)
hcu_owner_telemetry_snapshot + a single log line at shutdown and at each map boundary

staging_telemetry.reset_semantics: staging_reset refuses while any slot is non-FREE (counts reset_failures); quiescent reset preserves serials so stale tickets cannot alias reused slots
staging_telemetry.high_water_unit: bytes of occupied slot stride, not requested bytes (pre-existing semantics)

tests_run.outcome: not run: host lacks 32-bit libgcc (ld: cannot find -lgcc); ILP32 check remains open

requirement_results.evidence: Host-tested owner registry with nested-vs-backing separation and exact totals; staging request/reset/high counters tested; EE compile of registry passes.
requirement_results.remaining_limitation: No production owner is connected yet: game-state/object/actor pool counters live only in opt-in CE diagnostics, not in this registry; tags/BSP/streaming/scratch/audio have no snapshot producers (ps2_cache counters, texcache per-frame counters, audio requests absent); render chunks, render texture and DMA need the renderer lane's samplers; no ILP32 run; no target workload high-water measurement; actors.c/game_state.c/ps2_cache counters were not edited in this lane pass.

needed_cross_lane_changes: src/stream/hcu_main.c: init, note_capacity/used wiring and shutdown snapshot as listed in cross_lane_wiring
renderer lane: implement hcu_owner_sampler_fn for HCU_OWNER_RENDER_CHUNKS, HCU_OWNER_RENDER_TEXTURE and HCU_OWNER_DMA
